Blake Moore is fighting against the surging crisis, voting for H.R. 2 to secure the border and combat illegal immigration.
He is committed to keeping children safe from traffickers; strengthening our asylum system; and ending Biden’s catch and release approach.

At the same time, Blake believes in providing temporary worker visas to the Utah businesses that are creating jobs for Americans in our local economy, and assisting refugees from Ukraine and other war zones.

Blake Moore is fighting against Biden's tax-and-spend agenda and socialist efforts to kill jobs, lower wages, harm businesses, export jobs, and create massive new entitlement programs all while our current social programs rapidly approach fiscal cliffs.

Blake Moore continues to fight for Utahns' Second Amendment rights by opposing Biden's efforts to discriminate against gun owners and the Second Amendment community, defending our right to carry, and expanding recreational shooting and hunting access.
